newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oil close lower, softs active.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oil close lower, softs active.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices were mostly lower at the close on Tuesday with some fairly active trading reported in soft oils during the afternoon.
"The day started very quiet, but around mid-afternoon buyers started to take an interest and there were some quite big runs done in Feb/Apr and May/Jul soy oil," said a trader.
Palm oil finished lower despite news that Pakistan bought 4,000 tonnes of palm olein for shipment by December 20 at $577.93 a tonne c and f.

Coconut oil eased towards the close due to the arrival of a number of vessels carrying coconut oil in Europe this week. At the close Dutch soy oil was unchanged to one guilder down after Nov traded at 86.50, Dec at 88, Feb/Apr at 90.50 and May/Jul at 92 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Dutch/EU rape oil was two guilders down to 0.25 guilders up after Feb/Apr traded at 95, 95.25 and 95.50 guilders and May/Jul at 96.25 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Based on sellers' prices, the premium for rape oil over soy oil was 2.50 to six guilders at the close against 3.25 to 4.25 guilders on Monday.
Crude palm oil cif Europe finished $5 to $7.50 down after Nov traded at $560, Dec at $550 and Jan at $542.50 a tonne cif.
Refined palm oil closed $2.50 to $5 down and tradeless.
Coconut oil sellers were $15 to $25 down after Nov/Dec traded at $780, Dec/Jan at $745 and Jan/Feb at $720 a tonnne cif.
Palmkernel oil finished $5 lower after Dec/Jan traded at $720 a tonne cif.
